baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence خَلَقَ ... بِالْحَقِّ ... صَوَّرَكُمْ ... الْمَصِيرُ joins making, fitting, form, and outcome.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation is measured, fitted to its proper place, configured into excellent form, and oriented to an outcome; the ayah presents a calibrated arc rather than three unrelated claims.

activation_trace.role: Measurement and proportion make creation a calibrated act rather than bare origination.
A right that fits its joint or vessel sharpens بِالْحَقِّ into apt placement within the design.
Concrete configured form supplies the embodied middle stage of the arc.
Goodness against ugliness grades the configuration as excellent rather than merely existent.
Becoming toward an outcome gives the measured form its terminal axis.

changed_reading.before: The ayah separately reports cosmic creation, attractive human appearance, and eventual return.
changed_reading.after: The ayah traces one fitted process: measured creation becomes excellent embodied configuration and proceeds toward its appointed outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خَلَقَ and صَوَّرَكُمْ can distinguish inward created constitution from outward configured form, while أَحْسَنَ can name beneficent good-making.
baseline_models.mechanism: The person is made on two registers: an inward disposition and a visible configuration. Excellence can therefore describe an integrated endowment, not appearance alone.

activation_trace.role: Inward disposition supplies the concealed register of created personhood.
Visible configuration supplies the outward register paired with inward disposition.
Beneficent good action lets أَحْسَنَ describe active good-making across both registers.

changed_reading.before: صُوَرَكُمْ refers chiefly to bodily appearance.
changed_reading.after: The excellent human form is an integrated outward configuration and inward disposition bestowed through good-making.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: صَوَّرَكُمْ and صُوَرَكُمْ stand near وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ, allowing form and final becoming to share a directional mechanism.
baseline_models.mechanism: The form-root can carry inclination toward a direction, while the outcome-root can carry cutting, tilting, and movement toward resemblance. Human configuration becomes a vector: differentiated shaping already bears orientation toward the final return.

activation_trace.role: Inclination toward a direction turns static form into oriented shaping.
Cutting and tilting supplies differentiation and redirection on the way to an outcome.
Movement toward resemblance links becoming with the kind of form one comes to bear.

changed_reading.before: Form is a finished visual object and return is a later journey.
changed_reading.after: Form is directional configuration: created differences carry inclinations, and their trajectories converge in return to Him.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation supplies preparedness and power, but the same created addressees divide between covering and trusting responses that become intentional work. Excellent form is equipped possibility, not a guaranteed moral verdict.

activation_trace.role: Fitness and preparedness anchor excellent creation as capacity awaiting realization.
The good configuration is the endowed baseline whose use can still diverge.
Empowered ability makes the created endowment operational rather than decorative.
Covering the truth supplies one contrary realization of the same endowed capacity.
Heart-settling assent supplies the opposed trusting realization.
Intentional action converts latent capacity into an accountable trajectory.

structural_cues: 64:2 repeats creation of the plural addressee, then partitions that same group with مِنْكُمْ ... وَمِنْكُمْ before naming work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies empowered capacity, opposed cover/trust responses, and intentional work; I infer that excellent form enables rather than compels moral realization. A live alternative is that the moral partition merely follows an anatomical claim without revising it.

changed_reading.before: Excellent form sounds like a completed judgment that humans are already good.
changed_reading.after: Excellent form is a measured capacity whose realized moral shape depends on trust, concealment, and action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit hidden/public contrast and the chest as source of actions activate the focus distinction between inward constitution and outward image. Divine knowledge crosses both layers, so visible form cannot exhaust the person.

activation_trace.role: Inward disposition anchors the concealed human layer being known.
Visible configuration anchors the displayed human layer.
Uncovering to the knower bridges what the outward image shows and what it hides.
Concealment in the interior specifies the hidden side of the person.
Manifest disclosure specifies the outwardly legible side.
The source from which actions issue makes inward constitution causally active.

structural_cues: 64:4 balances what is concealed against what is announced, then closes by locating knowledge at ذات الصدور.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden and manifest poles plus an inward source of action; I infer that the focus form is layered embodiment under one knowing gaze. A live alternative is that 64:4 concerns knowledge generally and leaves صُوَرَكُمْ strictly external.

changed_reading.before: The excellence of form is fully available to sight.
changed_reading.after: Visible form is one layer of an excellent but accountable person whose concealed disposition also generates action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human surface dismissed as an unfit guide is precisely the carrier of a message that discloses meaning and delivers descending light. Bodily form is reread as a reception-and-transmission medium, not an obstacle to guidance.

activation_trace.role: Configured human embodiment anchors the medium through which guidance is carried.
Beneficent good-making lets excellence include communicative capacity.
Messenger and message place revelation inside a humanly borne relation.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign makes the embodied messenger legible.
Visible skin and surface name the very embodiment rejected as a guide.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies the function performed through that surface.
Illumination supplies what embodied perception and response are asked to receive.
Delivery downward supplies the transfer into the human field of reception.

structural_cues: 64:6 frames rejection as the question أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا, while 64:8 answers with an imperative to trust the light sent down.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human surface, messenger, disclosed sign, direction, light, and delivery; I infer that excellent embodiment is designed to mediate and receive guidance. A live alternative is that the passage only rebuts prejudice against human messengers without expanding 64:3.

changed_reading.before: Human form is a visual product of creation.
changed_reading.after: Human form is also a communicative interface through which guidance can be borne, recognized, and received.

context_deltas.mechanism: Experienced passage into a changed state, resurrection from stillness, regathering, evaluative loss, entry, and permanence unfold الْمَصِيرُ into a reconstituting and bifurcating process. Created form can be raised and gathered, then settled according to its realized trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Origination anchors the possibility of reconstitution after dispersal.
Becoming toward an outcome anchors the focus destination as a process.
Passing into a state after separation gives outcome an experienced transition.
Rousing what is still supplies the reactivation stage of return.
Joining what was scattered supplies bodily and communal reassembly.
Loss in a transaction makes the gathered outcome evaluative rather than neutral.
Entry into an interior turns destination into actual emplacement.
Stable persistence makes the emplacement enduring.
A place of settlement resolves the repeated destination into the contrasting terminal station.

structural_cues: 64:7 repeats resurrection, 64:9 repeats day and gathering, and 64:9-10 contrast enduring entry with the condemned destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transition, rousing, gathering, loss, entry, persistence, and settlement; I infer one staged return that reconstitutes form and sorts outcomes. A live alternative is that these are successive doctrines linked only by surah sequence, not an expansion of the focus wording.

changed_reading.before: الْمَصِيرُ is an unspecified endpoint after life.
changed_reading.after: الْمَصِيرُ is a staged reconstitution and audit: forms are raised, regathered, evaluated, and placed in divergent enduring outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: An event strikes its target under permission, the ordeal bears down, and faith is followed by guidance of the heart. The directional focus branches become dynamic: impacts can tilt embodied life, while guidance turns the inner core toward its outcome.

activation_trace.role: Inclination toward a direction anchors form as a trajectory susceptible to redirection.
Cutting and tilting make a changed course part of becoming.
A calamity that hits a person supplies the directional impact.
The split-root image of exhausting ordeal supplies pressure that can alter the course.
Permission places the impact within an allowed order rather than random collision.
Gentle direction toward the true path supplies the corrective vector.
Turning a thing from its face makes heart-guidance an actual reorientation.
Turning and destination explicitly connect the heart's inner change to الْمَصِيرُ.

structural_cues: 64:11 moves in one conditional sequence from an impacting calamity, through permission and faith, to guidance of the heart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies targeted impact, permitted ordeal, path-direction, and heart-turning; I infer that created form is dynamically reshaped along the road to return. A live alternative is that heart-guidance is consolation after calamity, not continuing formation.

changed_reading.before: Fashioning is complete at creation and return begins only at death.
changed_reading.after: Fashioning continues as lived orientation: impacts expose a course, and guided heart-turning begins the return within life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Obedience, turning away, a message reaching its goal, and entrusting oneself supply competing orientations. The final return is anticipated whenever the formed person yields, averts, or relies.

activation_trace.role: Directional inclination anchors the formed person's present orientation.
Movement toward an outcome anchors each present orientation in final return.
Yielding obedience supplies orientation by willing compliance.
Turning the back supplies the contrary bodily and moral direction.
Arrival at a goal parallels the message's reach with the person's destination.
Reliant entrustment supplies a positive present posture toward the One of return.

structural_cues: 64:12 repeats the command to obey, makes turning away the alternative, and 64:13 follows exclusive deity with an imperative of reliance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies compliance, aversion, arrival, and reliance; I infer that وَإِلَيْهِ names a present orientation as well as a future destination. A live alternative is that these commands regulate conduct without temporal overlap with الْمَصِيرُ.

changed_reading.before: Return is future movement imposed on every formed person.
changed_reading.after: Return is also rehearsed now through the formed person's obedience, aversion, reception, and reliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Paired intimacy can become hostility; pardon, erasure, and page-turning answer that pressure; family and wealth assay the person; and withholding exposes inner character. Excellent form becomes a relational and reformable moral configuration, not a private possession.

activation_trace.role: Inward disposition anchors the character tested in close relations.
Active good-doing anchors the possibility of reforming one's relational form.
A counterpart joined to its pair supplies the intimate field in which character takes shape.
Hostility inside intimacy supplies deformation pressure rather than an external enemy only.
Erasing an effect supplies one operation for changing the hostile pattern.
Turning and inspecting a page supplies a deliberate reconfiguration of response.
Assaying metal or a person makes family and wealth reveal the quality of inward form.
The self's force and character identify the inward material under assay.
Withholding as bad character names the deformation that reform must overcome.

structural_cues: 64:14 holds warning and three coordinated acts of release together; 64:15 names family and wealth a trial; 64:16 then locates the obstacle in the self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intimate pairing, hostility, erasure, page-turning, assay, self-character, and withholding; I infer an ethically plastic relational form. A live alternative is that these are commands addressed to already formed agents and do not revise صُوَرَكُمْ.

changed_reading.before: Each person's excellent form is a fixed individual endowment.
changed_reading.after: Human form also appears as relational character, exposed by intimate trial and capable of being remade through release and generosity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated goodness-root moves from God's excellent forming to a human good loan. What is cut out and advanced for return comes back multiplied, while even a little shows effect; good form becomes a generative practice with a return loop.

activation_trace.role: Beneficent action lets divine excellent forming seed an enacted human goodness.
Movement to an outcome anchors the return side of the good act.
Cutting out wealth or work so its recompense returns supplies the exchange mechanism.
The repeated good-action image transfers excellence from received form to offered deed.
Increase by an equal supplies the multiplied return of enacted goodness.
A little sufficing and showing its effect makes small goodness visibly generative.

structural_cues: 64:17 places حَسَنًا inside an if-then sequence: offer the good loan, then receive multiplication and forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated goodness-root, a contribution made for return, multiplication, and visible effect; I infer that received excellent form is meant to reproduce goodness in action. A live alternative is that حَسَنًا only qualifies the loan and does not echo 64:3 functionally.

changed_reading.before: God's making of excellent forms is a completed gift received by humans.
changed_reading.after: Excellent forming becomes reproducible: humans enact good form through giving, and that goodness enters a multiplied return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing pairing of unseen and witnessed, under comprehensive knowledge and precise wisdom, stabilizes the layered-person reading. Visible form is evidentiary but partial; its unseen roots and disposition remain within the Maker's exact knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Inward nature anchors the aspect of formed identity absent from sight.
Configured image anchors the aspect present to witness.
Uncovering to the knower spans both absent and present dimensions.
What is screened from eyes supplies the unseen dimension of personal form.
Presence with observation supplies the visible and witnessable dimension.
Precision and secure workmanship return both dimensions to deliberate excellent making.

structural_cues: The surah closes with the paired genitives الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ followed by names of power and wisdom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unseen/witnessed polarity, complete knowing, and precise workmanship; I infer that visible صُوَر is real evidence but not exhaustive identity. A live alternative is that the closing polarity describes divine omniscience without specifying human form.

changed_reading.before: Human form is the appearance that witnesses can inspect.
changed_reading.after: Human form has witnessed and unseen dimensions, both deliberately made and fully known even when observers see only one.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant resolver targets of س م و; it remains anchored in the supplied focus inventory and the focus contrast of cosmos, inward nature, and image, but downstream prose should call it a sign/mark activation rather than a translation of السَّمَاوَات.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split inventory for focus س م و places visible marking and inward property beside the explicit human image and inward-disposition branches.

activation_trace.role: A visible mark by which something is known makes the heavens an exploratory field of signs.
An inward special property counterpoints visible marking with hidden constitution.
Inward disposition transfers the marked/hidden polarity into the created person.
Visible image transfers the polarity's outward side into embodiment.

changed_reading.before: The heavens and human forms are separate items in a creation inventory.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the heavens model a marked sign-field while the person bears a visible image over an inward identifying property.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates rare sound-and-response images under ص و ر and ص ي ر; it remains anchored by both focus roots and the contextual utterance that rouses stillness, but it should be rendered only as a call-response analogy, never as the lexical sense of صُوَر or مَصِير.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Rare focus branches let formed life answer a caller and let destination ring, while 64:7 supplies utterance and awakening.

activation_trace.role: A bird answering a caller introduces responsive agency into the otherwise visual form-root.
A ringing instrument gives final becoming an exploratory resonance.
Rousing stillness supplies the awakening to which formed life responds.
Spoken utterance supplies the summons in the call-response mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Forms are silent visual products and resurrection is external movement.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, excellent forming equips responsive life to awaken at an address, and return is the creature's answering resonance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the non-dominant ع و د target resolved from contextual ع د و into the focus return-root; it remains inspectable through the same occurrence plus the adjacent release sequence, but prose should mark it as a resolver-triggered recurrence model, not redefine عَدُوّ as return.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus الْمَصِيرُ names return, while the split inventory under the family-enmity occurrence activates recurrence and return that pardon can interrupt.

activation_trace.role: Becoming toward return anchors recurrence in the focus destination.
Actual hostility supplies the relational pattern that recurs.
Return after departure supplies repetition within the hostile pattern.
Return and destination link recurrent family conflict back to the focus outcome-root.
Erasure supplies a way to interrupt the returning trace of hostility.
Turning the page supplies a replacement cycle rather than simple repetition.

changed_reading.before: Family hostility is a local trial unrelated to the return in 64:3.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, intimate hostility is a returning pattern within one's becoming, and pardon changes what one repeatedly becomes before final return.

strongest_changes: Excellent form shifted from static appearance to measured capacity whose moral realization can diverge.
الْمَصِيرُ expanded from endpoint into resurrection, gathering, divergent settlement, and present heart-turning.
Human form became both outward surface and inward disposition, tested and reformable in relationships.
The repeated ح س ن in 64:17 linked divine good-forming to human good action that returns multiplied.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest latent chain was directional: ص و ر and ص ي ر in the focus were reactivated by impact, heart-turning, guidance, aversion, and recurrence, while split mappings preserved marked, responsive, and kin-return readings that a conservative synthesis would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: How much weight non-dominant mapped roots should bear beyond exploratory activation.
Whether أَحْسَنَ primarily grades visible configuration, integrated disposition, or enacted beneficence; the trace keeps all three.
Whether the sound-response branches of ص و ر and ص ي ر are productive here or only packet-licensed analogy.
